grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK sign in credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm you are who you say you are before updating HMRC records

grants.description: Access your current HMRC records to display existing information
grants.purpose: To show you what information HMRC currently holds and what will change

grants.description: Authorise HMRC to update your personal records
grants.purpose: To update HMRC records with your new personal information

grants.description: Allow HMRC to recalculate your tax code based on changes
grants.purpose: Changes to your circumstances may affect your tax code, benefits or state pension entitlement

grants.description: Share your updated details with the Department for Work and Pensions (DWP)
grants.purpose: DWP needs updated information to ensure benefit payments and State Pension are correct

grants.description: Confirm your correspondence address for HMRC letters and notices
grants.purpose: HMRC will send tax-related correspondence and PAYE coding notices to this address

revocation.mechanism: Contact HMRC by phone on 0300 200 3300 or through your GOV.UK account
revocation.effect: Record changes will be cancelled if consent is revoked before submission. After submission, you will need to contact HMRC to reverse the changes.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide supporting documents (e.g. marriage certificate, deed poll) on your behalf. Agent cannot confirm changes that affect benefits or tax without your explicit approval at the review stage. Agent cannot update business records. For sensitive changes (bereavement, gender change), agent will hand off to human HMRC staff.
